setup: python3 -m pip install -q pytest ruff && npm install -g sass@1.80.6 typescript@5.6.3

check.fast: ruff check --select E9,F code-restructure/scripts tests tools && python3 -m py_compile code-restructure/scripts/*.py tools/*.py
check.full: ruff check --select E9,F code-restructure/scripts tests tools && python3 -m py_compile code-restructure/scripts/*.py tools/*.py && python3 tools/build_openai.py --zip && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
